new_page.description: New construction homes for sale in Downtown Vancouver: live MLS® listings of new and newly built homes, plus what homes there sold for over the past year.
new_page.h1: New Construction Homes for Sale in Downtown Vancouver

faq_heading: New construction in Downtown Vancouver: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Downtown Vancouver sold for?
faq.a: 454 condos sold in Downtown Vancouver at a median of $659,000, with the middle half between $549,000 and $841,325.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Downtown Vancouver?
faq.a: In Downtown Vancouver, condos were quickest at 25 days at a median, and townhomes slowest at 38 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Downtown Vancouver are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Downtown Vancouver, condos had the newest median build year, 2007.

blocks.text: What you see above is a live MLS® search for Downtown Vancouver: active houses, townhomes and condos with an age of 0 or less, so this year's completions and homes still being built. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in Downtown Vancouver was condos: 454 sales at a median of $659,000, and 2 types had 5 or more sales.

items.t: In Downtown Vancouver, townhomes sold at a median of $1,080,000 across 13 sales, and the middle half closed between $845,000 and $1,369,000. The median townhome sat 38 days and sold for 97.6% of list.
Downtown Vancouver: 454 condos sold at a median of $659,000, with the middle half between $549,000 and $841,325. The median condo took 25 days to sell and closed at 96.7% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Downtown Vancouver compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Townhomes in Downtown Vancouver have the 16th highest median of 18 Vancouver West sub-areas, $1,080,000. False Creek is lowest at $850,000 and Coal Harbour highest at $2,255,000. West End ($1,055,000) sits just below and Fairview ($1,080,000) sits just above.

Of 21 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Downtown Vancouver ranks second lowest at $659,000; the range is $613,500 (Marpole) to $1,228,000 (Coal Harbour). Marpole ($613,500) sits just below and S.W. Marine ($730,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Downtown Vancouver (median 2007) and townhomes the oldest (median 2006), a gap of 1 year.

48 buildings and complexes here had 3 or more resales in the past year. The newest is 1335 Howe, built in 2022, with 3 resales.
